channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (80)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 80

  • A large RAW opens from the camera preview, then a screen-sized picture.
  • Move to Trash is on the open photo.
  • Gallery shows the cull rating and the focus point.
  • Metadata is a column beside the photo.
  • Library commands use the usual names, and Panorama stays on the folder.
